photos.c: FRONTISPIECE (Ed.Lacey)------JOHN BICOURT leads Chris Perry of Birchfield Harriers in the final of the A.A.A. 3,000 metres Championship at White City. In his heat he chalked up a new Belgrave record of 8:46.8.
